changelog: v1.0.0: Agent call tracing + golden-case regression loop + cost attribution + error fingerprinting
summary: Record every tool call into agent-tracer (self-hosted FastAPI), then run regression testing (golden case → drift detection), attribute token costs by tool/model/agent, and surface recurring error root causes across sessions. Use when an agent must log its actions, verify behavior hasn't drifted, report spend, or debug repeated failures.
